purpose: Define the promotion gate from immutable LPC Structure source sheets into exact PublishedWorldAsset structure_component/structural_connector records without reusing ordinary ObjectKind placeholder art.

topology: opening/socket role for doors windows stairs bridges and connectors
vertical tier or level delta when applicable
runtimeEditorParity: same PublishedWorldAsset identity in editor and runtime
same source/cache recipe in editor and runtime
presentation: active structural level visibility role where applicable
camera-local occlusion group for roof/front-wall/cutaway components
presentation visibility must not mutate shared world state

rolePolicies.floor: tileable interior surface family; not exterior generic ground authority
rolePolicies.wall: directional/connected interior or building-shell component with explicit corners/ends and camera-local cutaway/occlusion metadata where applicable
rolePolicies.wall_border: overlay/trim attached to a compatible wall family
rolePolicies.door: opening component with closed/open states and traversal socket; never a generic object-atlas cell
rolePolicies.window: wall-attached opening/overlay with facing and wall compatibility
rolePolicies.roof: building-shell occluder group tied to BuildingInstance visibility; exact roof grammar required before promotion; never a ground tile
rolePolicies.stairs: level connector with facing, footprint, entry/exit sockets and explicit vertical delta
rolePolicies.fence: connected boundary family with straight/corner/end/gate roles
rolePolicies.bridge: route connector spanning a compatible gap/water class with bank sockets
rolePolicies.platform: structural surface/stamp with edge and access rules
rolePolicies.pillar: support/trim component with structure attachment and sort root
rolePolicies.sign: structure/town sign component using real sign source art, not standing-screen substitution

forbiddenShortcuts: generic Door/Fence/Stairs ObjectKind atlas fallback as production authority
whole source sheet promoted as one ordinary placeable
generated atlas identity replacing source provenance
building reference sheet treated as a production BuildingRecipe without decomposition
